findings.description: README.md presents 'Install from the Jellyfin plugin repository' and the 'Manual install (fallback)' download of ArrTags_1.0.1.0.zip as currently available, with no caveat that the v1.0.1 manifest/tag/release are still local-only and unpublished. A reader following README.md before the user runs the publish step would fail at both install paths. This is the carried-forward Phase 8 LOW finding (8.1-R2 / phase-8 review finding 2); the canonical current-state surfaces (docs/limitations.md P6, docs/project-status.md, docs/release/build-and-release.md) are correct and conditioned, so this is a README-honesty gap, not a project-state overclaim. It becomes accurate as soon as the user publishes.

findings.description: scripts/publish-release.sh --release-only checks that manifest.json and the local tag exist but does not verify that the local release artifact exists nor that its MD5 equals the manifest checksum before uploading; a stale/regenerated artifact would be uploaded first and only rejected by the post-upload verification. The jq-less checksum fallback also selects the first manifest checksum rather than the target guid/version. Reachable only through the user's manual publish step; jq is present here and the documented artifact/checksum are correct. Carried-forward Phase 8 LOW (8.4-R2/R3 / phase-8 review finding 5).

findings.recommended_action: Optional post-V1 hardening: fail fast when the local artifact is missing and compare its MD5 to the manifest checksum before upload, and tighten the jq-less fallback. Not required for V1.

limitations_accepted: F1 - No provider inventory/catalogue cache; one provider-library read per work item. Consequence: GOALS criterion 6 only partially met for provider fetches; render/publication unaffected. Evidence: docs/limitations.md F1.
F2 - Runtime configuration replacement is not wired to Jellyfin's save path; saved config changes are observed only after a restart. Evidence: docs/limitations.md F2.
F3 - No bounded, secret-free metrics/diagnostic-status surface. Evidence: docs/limitations.md F3.
F4 - Reconciliation coverage is bounded by QueueCapacity (default 512); successive runs may not advance past a prefix. Evidence: docs/limitations.md F4.
F5 - The renderer depends on a host-supplied SkiaSharp with no bundled fallback; a host without a compatible SkiaSharp fails closed. Evidence: docs/limitations.md F5 / ADR-015.
V1 - No live Sonarr or Radarr release instance; provider behavior exercised against committed fixtures. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V1.
V2 - ADR-010 non-canonical cross-runtime comparison unselected and unrun. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V2.
V3 - Jellyfin Enhanced coexistence verified at the contract level only (not installed on the pinned host). Evidence: docs/limitations.md V3.
V4 - Live IProviderManager.SaveImage read-back is manual, not an automated live test. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V4.

V5 - Live Plugin.OnUninstalling drain was historically manual-only; this review independently re-ran the authenticated live uninstall drain for 1.0.1.0 (204; install folder and state root removed; artwork restored), so the live gap is closed for this release while the automated-live-test gap remains. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V5 and this report's live_checks.
V6 - Host-guarded facts skip without the pinned host; default suite is 1228/60/1288 and host-guarded is 1244/44/1288. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V6.
P1 - Byte-reproducibility depends on the pinned toolchain (SDK 10.0.x); no automated test guards archive byte-identity. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P1.
P2 - Reduced debug metadata (no commit suffix, no SourceLink) for reproducibility. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P2.
P3 - PackagePlugin=true stages but does not write the archive; ./build.sh package is the entry point. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P3.
P4 - SkiaSharp license notices ship although SkiaSharp is not redistributed. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P4.
P5 - Pre-release orphaned PluginsPath/ArrTags data folder and incomplete-drain state-root retention require manual handling. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P5.

P6 - The v1.0.1 tag, manifest commit 8cba85b, and the artifact are local only: no push, no GitHub release, no asset upload; the public repository does not yet serve a 1.0.1.0 manifest, so catalog install cannot resolve ArrTags until the user runs scripts/publish-release.sh. D1 - Webhook 401 carries a framework application/problem+json ProblemDetails body versus ADR-012's 'no body' wording (bounded, no sensitive detail). Evidence: docs/limitations.md D1.
D2 / SEC-6 - ArtworkSubjectGate.Gates has no idle eviction (bounded by distinct library items; not attacker-controllable). Evidence: docs/limitations.md D2/SEC-6.

RR-15 - Mock fixture API keys appear in tracked documentation (deliberate local mock values, never production). Evidence: docs/limitations.md RR-15.

SEC-4 (INFORMATIONAL) - Authentication error bodies carry generic framework ProblemDetails detail (the D1 gap). Evidence: docs/limitations.md SEC-4.

summary: The ArrTags 1.0.1.0 release candidate is safe to ship. Provenance is unambiguous: working tree clean at HEAD 2494597 (34 commits ahead of origin/main 09596e0), annotated tag v1.0.1 (object b5b2706...) at commit 8cba85b, and the repository manifest.json identical at tag and HEAD. This audit independently reproduced the release artifact from a clean `git archive v1.0.1` export and obtained a byte-exact match to the recorded identity - 568,248 bytes, SHA-256 de4c34841d77b5ff74b6bc9edeb515a4c5fcc5a9b09d7d24a2da5d64d31b4b8c, MD5 16baa5a7324b8e14fdb113d84b944d09, 7 entries with matching per-entry hashes, no bundled SkiaSharp/Jellyfin runtime, and no embedded secrets. Build was 0 warnings / 0 errors; the test matrix passed (default 1228/60/1288, host-guarded 1244/44/1288, PluginPackagingTests 7/7, forced-native SkiaHostCompatibilityTests 2/2). The full live end-to-end path was independently re-run for the 1.0.1.0 package on the pinned Jellyfin 12.0.0 musl host: install/load with 0 [FTL]/[ERR], badge publication through the real host IProviderManager.SaveImage with served bytes equal to the persisted ActiveImageIdentity, original source artwork byte-unchanged, unchanged metadata not republished and changed metadata republished, provider outage leaving the host up with current artwork, restart preserving install and state, and an authenticated uninstall drain (204) removing the install folder and state root and restoring the original posters. The plugin source is unchanged from the live-verified 0.1.0 release (`git diff a634d61..HEAD -- src` empty), so the webhook/SEC-1 boundary and deeper corruption/atomicity coverage are justifiably reused, and the 0.1.0 security review (APPROVED) plus the recorded accepted findings (SEC-2..SEC-8) remain valid. All phase reviews are APPROVED with no open BLOCKER/HIGH; historical blockers 7.2-F1 and 7.3-F1 were resolved by ADR-014/ADR-015 and re-verified live. The canonical docs are honest: every surface conditions catalog availability on the user's pending publish, and docs/limitations.md P6 accurately records that the tag/manifest/release are local-only. No BLOCKER or HIGH finding remains open; the remaining items are LOW (README pre-publication caveat, publish-script pre-check) and INFORMATIONAL, all accepted and recorded. Decision: SHIP_WITH_ACCEPTED_LIMITATIONS, keeping tag v1.0.1 at 8cba85b; the user should run scripts/publish-release.sh --release-only to push the branch/tag, create the GitHub release, and upload the asset.
